classification.difficultyReason: Select among right-triangle ratios and both triangle rules, sometimes after angle sum.

content.prompt: Use an appropriate method to find the unknown. Give lengths to 1 d.p. and angles to nearest degree.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\theta}{7.2}&=\frac{\sin116^\circ}{10.8}\\[8pt]\sin\theta&=\frac{7.2\sin116^\circ}{10.8}\\[8pt]\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{7.2\sin116^\circ}{10.8}\right)\\[8pt]\theta&\approx37^\circ\end{align*}$$
The supplementary angle is impossible with $116^\circ$.
